scope: Each entry binds one paper claim to a publication-facing record, content digest, machine-readable assertions, and an offline replay command.

reproducibility_levels.audit: Verify C1-C12 record digests and expected assertions offline.
reproducibility_levels.replay: Recompute the reported arithmetic and categorical outcomes from packaged records and replay inputs.
reproducibility_levels.reconstruction: Inspect the recorded source, runtime patches, contracts, model identities, workload identities, and resource controls needed for a new execution of the principal C1-C3 paths.

C1.headline: Output-exact execution beyond full residency
C1.certificate_scope: W / H=cgroup-charge hard / G=audit+physical / E[E_64-out,64] / L=clean no-fault closure
C1.paper_claim: At one Qwen3-Next 32K+64 identity, the complete representation and the semantic-demand lower bound exceed the declared aggregate budget; the execution remains resource-admissible and matches one zero-cache oracle across all 64 complete logit rows, token IDs, response bytes, recorded routes, the seven-field consumer identity, and the two-entry destination identity.

C2.headline: Six-pair complete asynchronous-component comparison
C2.paper_claim: Across six fixed-identity D/F pairs, the complete eight-window asynchronous component has geometric F/D wall ratio 0.322913 with paired-log 95% interval [0.320090, 0.325762], or 3.10x reciprocal, at identical physical source bytes per output.

C3.headline: All fourteen prespecified fault/control cells
C3.certificate_scope: L[F14] at the recorded Qwen3-Next and Gemma executable identities
C3.paper_claim: All fourteen prespecified Qwen3-Next and Gemma control/fault cells satisfy their validators; seven fatal cells publish no accepted output and five recoverable cells remain control-exact and close.

C4.headline: Qwen3.6 multi-token-prediction temporal amortization
C4.paper_claim: One Qwen3.6 8,192+512 request produces one prefill output and traverses the remaining 511 outputs in 104 target traversals at 12.016 end-to-end output tokens/s with scoped exact logits, tokens, and hybrid-state rebasing.

C5.headline: Qwen-specific natural-task utility
C5.paper_claim: The fixed Qwen-specific population preserves aggregate F1 0.590909 while request-plus-reset time falls from 331.884 to 235.917 seconds (28.916%).

C6.headline: Shared-Plan comparison with preserved F1 miss
C6.paper_claim: The distinct shared-Plan comparison reduces request-plus-reset time from 335.400 to 250.785 seconds (25.228%) while preserving the prespecified -0.0015625 aggregate F1 criterion miss.

C7.headline: Gemma cache transfer
C7.paper_claim: Across five exact Gemma pairs, H2D bytes fall 65.021%, process physical reads 61.474%, and aggregate decode time 77.517%.

C8.headline: Bounded Gemma direct source
C8.paper_claim: The bounded Gemma source reduces complete-host peak from 6,641,348,608 to 2,980,458,496 bytes and balances 14,396 direct-I/O submissions and completions with scoped exactness.

C9.headline: Cross-model product comparison
C9.paper_claim: On five response-format-aligned repository tasks, both paths complete 5/5, while Qwen3-Next is 4.965x slower in total wall time and 14.126x slower to first useful action than resident Qwen3.6.

C10.headline: GPT-OSS-20B storage-device result
C10.paper_claim: The prespecified GPT-OSS-20B contiguous-pack criterion fails on the recorded RTX 3080 Ti storage path while fixed-history exactness and lifecycle closure pass.

C11.headline: Llama-3.3-70B placement and task result
C11.paper_claim: The exact Llama-3.3-70B IQ2_M placement meets its GPU margin but passes only one of four fixed task-admission cells.

C12.headline: Shared-Plan execution parity
C12.paper_claim: The shared-Plan execution-parity process schedules 3,384 objects per request through 144 host windows and eight GPU slots with balanced teardown.
